title: Coefficient coherence of scalar pullback
statement: Fix any presentations $m$ of the normalized scalar derived adjunctions [def-sp-open-scalar-tensor-data]. For finite commutative rings $A\xrightarrow{\varphi}B\xrightarrow{\psi}C$, any open immersion $j:U\to X$ [def-weil-open-immersion], and arbitrary $Q\in D(X,A)$, put $S_T^\varphi=-\otimes_A^LB$ and $r_R=j_R^{-1}$. Let $\lambda^\varphi:S_X^\varphi;r_B\cong r_A;S_U^\varphi$ be the specified scalar/inverse-image comparison, with semicolon denoting functor application in order. For the recorded scalar composition isomorphisms $\alpha_T:S_T^\varphi;S_T^\psi\cong S_T^{\psi\varphi}$, including constant-sheaf composition transports, one has $S_U^\psi((\lambda^\varphi_Q)^{-1});(\lambda^\psi_{S_X^\varphi Q})^{-1};r_C(\alpha_{X,Q})=\alpha_{U,r_AQ};(\lambda^{\psi\varphi}_Q)^{-1}$. For the identity coefficient map, with the recorded scalar unitor $\iota_T$, one has $(\lambda^{\mathrm{id}}_Q)^{-1};r_A(\iota_{X,Q})=\iota_{U,r_AQ}$. This assertion involves no extension by zero or beta comparison and assumes no tensor choices, boundedness or coefficient flatness.

proof.text: At the ordinary module-sheaf level the restriction/inverse-image square commutes with coefficient composition and identities on every section. Localize these equalities with the exact-functor composition comparisons, retaining their associators and the constant-sheaf transports.

Take scalar adjunction mates of the coefficient-composition and identity diagrams for exact restriction and inverse image. Mate pasting identifies the scalar compositors with scalarHomExtensionComp and the identity comparison with scalarHomExtensionId, since both are the conjugates of the same restriction comparison. The scalar-presentation changes are compatible by naturality of the scalar units. Finally insert the constant-sheaf composition and identity equality transports used in scalarComp and scalarId. This gives precisely the two inverse-lambda equations, with no open extension functor.
